purpose: synthetic development fixture only; never evidence, observed data, or final evaluation
generation_method: Synthetic values generated from source distribution summaries (calendar-month medians/variation and annual log trends); no source rows are copied.
temporal_rule: Annual synthetic features use data_year = forecast_year - 2 and become available January 1 of forecast_year. This mirrors a provisional project assumption, not verified release vintages.

synthetic_label_rule.name: synthetic_demo_future_price_stress
synthetic_label_rule.definition: 1 when the maximum synthetic real price in the next horizon months is at least (1 + threshold_fraction) times the current synthetic real price; otherwise 0; final rows without full horizon are blank.
synthetic_label_rule.status: illustrative only; replace with a team-approved outcome/horizon/threshold for real evaluation

limitations: All rows and labels are synthetic; demo_split is not a validated train/test split.
Weather is calibrated from a single NASA POWER point, not a wheat-area or national signal.
Annual lags are a provisional proxy; no publication vintages are simulated.
The synthetic event injections are invented scenarios, not historical event reconstructions or causal claims.
Generated data are local development fixtures and should not be published as observations.
